dedupe_keys.name: spineopt demo for the iea ebc annex 83 summer school

description: Topi Rasku at VTT publishes a Spine Toolbox example combining building models processed by ArchetypeBuildingModel with a simple SpineOpt energy system. The source explicitly says this version was updated for SpineOpt performance profiling; the older summer-school version may no longer run unchanged. The described datastores separate building definitions, energy-system inputs and combined model input. Listed source data include Finnish and Estonian 2015 electricity information and renewable capacity factors. Zenodo provides free access, but package parts have different licences: general MIT or CC BY 4.0 terms and CC BY-NC 4.0 for Renewables.ninja data. Coverage is a demonstration, not a validated operational power-system model. Related SpineOpt, Spine Toolbox and ArchetypeBuildingModel entries describe the general tools. A limitation is that the package was not executed and its data values, runtime performance and compatibility were not checked. No code or archive body was fetched.
